Check-runs on `76220ce3` read once at 2026-10-27T02:05Z: 50 runs, none in progress; every non-skipped run `success` — `Type Check · source gates` (carries `check-skills-token-ratchet` + its self-test, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`), `Type Check · consumer gates` (carries `check:skill-examples`), `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, Build Core, Test Core 1–8/8; the UI, docs, dogfood-shard and opt-in runs `skipped` (filter). Diff against the merge-base `756220c4` is exactly the three files of the file list (+41/−4); `references/_index.md` is byte-identical.

### ① Derived judgments

(a) Every new sentence against the spec and the CLI on `origin/main` (`translation.zod.ts` is the spec; `i18n-extract.ts` is what `os i18n extract` writes).

- `_views.{view_name}` row gains `title` — RIGHT. `translation.zod.ts` 304–320 declares `title` on `_views` as a form view's heading, applied only where the form authors one; a list view carries none (318: the key over one resolves nothing). The row's parenthetical restates exactly that.
- `_sections.{section_name}` row gains `fields.{field_name}` with `label`, `placeholder`, `helpText` — RIGHT, and the spelling note is right: 476–490 declare the three keys with `helpText` canonical and `help` as the alias (483), while the object-level `FieldTranslationSchema` (119–125) spells it `help` with `helpText` as the alias (122). The dispatch order's "Correction A" (teach `help`, name `helpText` as alias) was wrong for this nested row; the dev read the schema and withdrew it, which is the correct reading. No duplicate object-level `fields` row was added.
- Top-level group list — COMPLETE. `appTranslationDataShape()` declares, in order: `objects` 888, `picklists` 902, `apps` 914, `messages` 931, `globalActions` 954, `dashboards` 968, `datasets` 1100, `reports` 1161, `pages` 1210, `flows` 1571, `positions` 1698, `permissions` 1721, `metadataForms` 1776, `settingsCommon` 1807 — fourteen; `settings` (1884) is the platform-only fifteenth, which the skill already refuses by name. The head's list names all fourteen (thirteen beside `objects`); no group is omitted. `picklists` was never listed before and is a real per-app group, so adding it is inside "lists every top-level group" (Wanted), not beyond it.
- `picklists` (`label`, `options` by stored value — every field referencing the picklist inherits them) — RIGHT (894–911).
- `reports`, `positions`, `permissions` hold `label` + `description` by name — RIGHT (1161–1168, 1698–1705, 1721–1728). "`permissions` (permission sets, spelled as the stack's `permissions[]`)" — RIGHT: `stack.zod.ts:808` `permissions: z.array(PermissionSetSchema)`, and the spec comment at 1710–1713 says the group is spelled as the stack spells the collection; `permissionSets` is an alias the door rewrites (1958).
- `pages.{page}.components.{tabs_id}.items.{value}.label` "(by the item's `value`; an item without one has no key)" — RIGHT (1353–1359, the describe at 1359 says exactly that).
- `flows.{flow}.approvals.{node_id}.label` — RIGHT (1668–1680; keyed by the `approval` node's `FlowNode.id`).
- "`os i18n extract --no-objects-only` scaffolds every group above, both keys included" — WRONG for two of the thirteen groups the sentence points at. The walk surface (`i18n-extract.ts` 63–129) and the walk itself (1620–1630 `walkReports` / `walkPicklists` / `walkSecurityCatalog`, 1314 the `page:tabs` items, 2237 `approvals.NODE.label`, 2271–2306 `metadataForms` into its companion module) write `objects`, `globalActions`, `apps`, `dashboards`, `datasets`, `reports`, `picklists`, `pages`, `flows`, `positions`, `permissions`, `metadataForms` — and NOTHING for `messages` (free-form ids; zero `['messages'` emission in the file) or `settingsCommon` (zero hits in `i18n-extract.ts` and `commands/i18n/extract.ts`). `--no-objects-only` maps to `kind: 'stack'` (2705–2722), whose payload is `stackAuthoredSubtree(data)` (2559–2562) — everything the walk harvested minus `metadataForms` — so the module an author gets holds no `messages` and no `settingsCommon` skeleton. The liveness ledger gates nothing today (`packages/spec/liveness/translation.json` carries no top-level `authorWarn`; the `flows` warn was dropped 2026-10-05), so the twelve walked groups and both nested keys ARE scaffolded; "every group above" is the overclaim. The card's Wanted asks for "a pointer to the scaffold if it writes them" — the pointer is right for the two keys and for `reports` / `positions` / `permissions` / `picklists`; the word "every" makes the sentence false for two groups in the same list, and this audit exists because that list "read as complete". FAIL item; the fix is one clause (e.g. "scaffolds every group above but `messages` and `settingsCommon`, both keys included"), a few tokens inside SKILL.md's 1075-token headroom, no ratchet row moves.
- The spec-line citations in the PR body (`translation.zod.ts` 303–320, 455–490, 902–911, 1161–1168, 1353–1359, 1668–1680, 1698–1705, 1721–1728; `i18n-extract.ts` 63–131) all resolve on `origin/main` at `b33dd25b`; the card body's 602-608 / 724 / 1140-1143 were stale, as the dev's deviation says (724 is the `PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY` message that lists the groups, not the declarations).

(b) Cuts — none. The diff deletes nothing beyond the three lines it respells (`_views` row, `_sections` row, the group list's closing line), and every clause of each survives in its replacement. Shared Acceptance "nothing is removed beyond the stale lines this card names" holds; ruling A's "cut duplicates first" was applied to the raised file and found nothing to cut (judged below).

(c) Ratchet rows. The script's measure is `Math.ceil(Buffer.byteLength(text,'utf8') / 4)` with the stamped `version:` line excluded on SKILL.md only (header 44–113, `TOKEN_CONVENTION`, `stampLine`). Recomputed over the blobs: `evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` 4016 bytes → 1004 on `origin/main` (= the old row), 5802 bytes → 1451 on the head (= the new row): pinned AT the measurement, zero headroom, no smuggled budget. `SKILL.md` 20131 − 20 → 5028 on main, 21050 − 20 → 5258 on the head, ceiling 6333 untouched (headroom 1305 → 1075) — the body's and report's numbers are exact. Arithmetic: evals +447, SKILL +230, bundle +677, ceilings +447 — consistent in the row comment, the body and the report. The raise rule (header 127–129: the other direction "lands only in a PR whose body quotes a maintainer ruling authorizing it") is met: the PR body quotes the tap 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 verbatim and names the card it was tapped on; the row comment carries the same quotation (the script itself reads no comment and no body; `check-ratchet-remedy-authority` only anchors SHRINK testimony near the `CEILINGS` declaration, and the new rows sit inside the map, below the doc comment, so the anchor is undisturbed — green on the head). Ruling A's duplicate-cut first: read the five existing prompts on `origin/main` — bundle authoring, a new locale, the `translation` item, a plugin's generated bundle, the `--objects-only` diagnosis — five distinct surfaces, no restated teaching; the dev's "no duplicate content to cut" is right, so the remainder is the whole addition and the raise is exactly it. No `max-len` rule exists in `eslint.config.mjs` on `origin/main`; `Lint · ESLint` is green on the head. One row touched, inside the amended claim surface (CEILINGS rows of `skills/objectstack-i18n/` files this PR touches); no logic, no other row.

(d) Evals. Ids 6 and 7 are unique and sequential after 1–5; the file parses; `must_contain` strings all appear in each `expected_output`; `must_not_contain` strings (`permissionSets`, `report: {`, `stepLabel`, `_tabs.overview`) are the real wrong spellings (`permissionSets` and `report` are aliases the door rewrites, 1958; `stepLabel` is the `approvals` alias, 1675). Eval 6's `expected_output` names `permissionSets` inside its own "never …" clause — the same pattern 22 existing prompts across the skills use (e.g. `objectstack-data` id 2 names `many_to_many` in its expected output while forbidding it), and no runner reads these files (the ratchet row comment at 590 and a repo-wide grep: no script reads `must_contain`), so it is consistent with the file's shape. Eval 6 IS the card-specific acceptance (a report and a permission set, plus a position and a picklist); eval 7 covers the four nested keys. Every new teaching has a prompt. No README or SKILL.md index counts prompts.

(e) Wanted lines — all met: `:169-172` lists every group (14/14); `:163` adds `title`; `:165` adds `fields.FIELD` (`label`, `placeholder`, `helpText`); one line each for the tab item and approval step paths plus the scaffold pointer (the pointer being the sentence faulted in (a)). Line 1 of SKILL.md untouched (PR #25640's). Nothing outside the claim + amendment surface. Whole-file and whole-package before/after counts (503 → 510, 55 → 75, package 533 → 540, tokens 6032 → 6709) are in the body and exact.

(f) PR body. Line 1 is the harness attribution HTML comment, line 2 the `_Requested by_` line, line 3 `Fixes #26296`, lines 4–5 `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial — the shape os-dev.md 323 exempts on `origin/main` ("harness 自写的 PR 正文首行归属注释原样留、只报;`Fixes` 紧随其后"), and the dev reports it in `deviations`. No parser requires `Fixes` on line 1: `check-closing-target-claim` / `check-closing-keyword-parity` / `check-partof-closing-keyword` read keywords anywhere, and all three card-relation check-runs are green. `## 维护者速读` carries the six labels in order; 需要你做的 = exactly one action (批准, Tier H); 先看 = three files naming the risky hunk (the ceiling row); 两分钟验证 = one command with the expected sight, which matches the script's print format `REL is N tokens (ceiling C; headroom H).` (896). English sections What changes / Why / Tests / Acceptance notes / Verification with details blocks — the relative order os-dev.md asks for holds, `Why` inserted from the new PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE. One inconsistency to patch: the body's Verification says 52 derived, 47 green, 5 NOT MEASURED, while the report (6431884295) says 51 green, 1 NOT MEASURED after the closure build; the dev names it in `deviations` and did not PATCH the body (one write at `pr_create`).

(g) Report. os-dev-report 6431884295 on the card at 2026-10-27T02:01Z carries `deviations` (8), `line_budget`, `out_of_scope_findings` (2), `files_changed`; no `rules_retired` (the os-dev.md template on the head declares neither field; the order asked for the three it carries). Branch = the claim's `claude/project-thread-mu5kbd`; `mcp_calls: 0`; writes = `pr_create` through the relay + the report through post-stamped; assignee and `skip-changeset` written by the relay. The `--objects-only` paragraph observation (SKILL.md 401–405 lists six coverage kinds; `i18n-coverage.ts` 356–386 and 440–455 also report `dataset`, `report`, `picklist`, `position`, `permission` buckets) is read as INCOMPLETE, not false: the paragraph says "also demands … keys" without claiming the list is exhaustive, and eval 5 mirrors it; a one-clause tighten for the lane, not this card.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `skills/objectstack-i18n/` carries no `package.json` (SKILL.md, `evals/`, `references/` only); `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` ships in no package's `files[]` (the root is `@objectstack/spec-monorepo`, `private: true`). `Check Changeset` is green on the head. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial and right (the skill teaches keys the protocol already carries; no schema moves).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Base: the PR's base sha `abb90460` is an ancestor of `origin/main` (tip `b33dd25b`, three commits newer); the merge-base with the head is `756220c4`. None of `756220c4..origin/main` touches `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` or `skills/objectstack-i18n/**` (`git log` over those paths is empty), so the ratchet row and the skill rebase cleanly; `mergeable_state: clean`.
- The dispatch order's premise check had the `help` / `helpText` alias direction reversed for the nested `_sections.SECTION.fields.FIELD` row (true only for the object-level row). The dev caught it by reading the schema. A 收班简报 note for the premise-check method (read the nested shape, not the neighbouring row), not a card.
- The `--objects-only` paragraph's six-kind list (above, ①(g)): a note for the `domain:skills` lane; not filed, not blocking.
- The report's `mcp_calls` and `deviations` fields name model ids (the thread's switch history); the commit trailer pair and the PR carry none, as os-dev.md requires. Nothing to do on this PR; a note that the report template's `mcp_calls` line invites it.

Inside SKILL.md's headroom; no ratchet row moves; eval 6's "scaffolds all four" stays true.
